claims.text: An integrated DFT-CALPHAD-machine-learning approach can accurately predict melting temperature across high-entropy alloys.
The integrated approach can accurately predict enthalpy and entropy of fusion across high-entropy alloys.
The integrated approach can accurately predict volume change at melting and key liquid-phase thermodynamic properties across high-entropy alloys.
Combining DFT, CALPHAD, and machine-learning regression is computationally efficient.
The target high-entropy alloys contain multiple principal elements in near-equiatomic ratios.
The target alloys possess chemical disorder and atomic-size mismatch.
DFT can provide local energetic and structural descriptors for chemically disordered high-entropy alloys.
Integrating DFT outputs into CALPHAD models can map phase equilibria.
Machine-learning regression can generalize fusion-property predictions across high-entropy-alloy composition space.
Chemical disorder, atomic-size mismatch, and local atomic configurations mediate energy barriers and configurational entropy.
CALPHAD translates local DFT energetics and structural information into macroscopic free-energy landscapes.
Machine learning can efficiently interpolate physics-based inputs across compositions to predict fusion-related properties.
Predicted melting temperatures will be within approximately 5–10% of experimental values.
Predicted enthalpies and entropies of fusion will be accurate to approximately 10%.
Predicted volume changes at melting will be accurate to approximately 10%.
The integrated framework will improve accuracy and computational efficiency relative to single-method approaches.
DFT-only approaches are computationally prohibitive for broad high-entropy-alloy composition spaces.
Traditional CALPHAD alone is inadequately predictive across broad high-entropy-alloy composition spaces.
The proposed approach applies primarily to homogeneous disordered solid-solution high-entropy alloys.
Substantial ordering, clustering, or extreme atomic-size mismatch may limit the approach's performance.
